items.title: 4.2.4 Tree: Best for Hierarchical Data (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of when to use a tree (PDF 117-118).

blocks.text: Walidain-aulad rishton wale darja-bandi ke data ke liye tree istemal karein: darja-bandi wale databases jaise tanzeemi dhanche, file systems aur XML ya HTML documents; tez talash, dakhile aur hatane ke liye binary search trees; aur compilers, jo code ki banawat samajhne ke liye trees istemal karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Computer ka folder nizam tree kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Har folder ka ek walid folder hota hai aur us mein kai sub-folders aur files ho sakti hain, ek jarr se shuru ho kar.
